resources.string: OMY configuration
Runtime status, KeyMint configuration and app scope
Manager local WebUI for Oh My Keymint. Opening or refreshing this page only reads runtime state. Keybox contents are never read or displayed.
Refresh runtime state

Raw TOML: /data/misc/keystore/omk/config.toml. Save only when you intend to apply your edits. No TOML syntax validation is performed here. A backup is saved beside it as config.toml.webui.bak; replacement uses owner 1017:1017 and mode 0660. Restart KeyMint after changing settings that require a restart.

Scope source: /data/adb/tricky_store/target.txt. Keep one package per line; existing comments, ! / ? suffixes and optional keybox filenames can remain. Saving creates target.txt.webui.bak. The carrier regenerates injector.toml within about 15 seconds and its watcher reloads scope; refresh to check.
Read-only generated runtime injector configuration. Edit target.txt above to change scoop. Direct edits to this generated file would be overwritten.

Restart buttons create a request marker in /data/adb/omk. The runtime service consumes the marker; this does not confirm a successful restart. Save first, then request a restart. Restarting can briefly interrupt attestation.
Read-only: file missing, unreadable, a symbolic link, or larger than 128 KiB. This page does not create missing runtime files.
